verdict.rationale: The evidence suggests a programmatic surface: a `patchLog` method (docs-29) and a `gateway: { id: "my-gateway" }` code option (docs-36). The OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint (docs-18) and parameter-based provider switching (docs-22) also imply developers can build with existing provider SDKs, and an OpenAPI spec is published (probe-3). However, no official Cloudflare AI Gateway SDK package is explicitly named or documented. Missing for 10: explicitly named official SDK packages and languages, SDK reference documentation, install and usage guides, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
